sentences.japanese: トムは美しい貝がらを浜辺でひろった。
sentences.english: Tom picked up some pretty shells on the beach.

sentences.japanese: 火力とお鍋と貝の種類によるわ。
sentences.english: It depends on the strength of the flame, the pan used and the type of ingredients.

sentences.japanese: プレゼントにするきれいな貝がらをひろいにいったよ！
sentences.english: I went looking for pretty shells as a present!

sentences.japanese: 私が手にしてるのは貝の化石です。
sentences.english: What I have in my hand is a fossil seashell.
